content: GitHub Actions for pnpm+Turborepo monorepos (turborepo.dev official guide + community templates): pnpm/action-setup + actions/setup-node with node-version-file, cache pnpm keyed on lockfile, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; turbo run lint typecheck test build with Turborepo remote cache optional; job graph install->(typecheck/lint/test/build) with Postgres service containers for integration tests; concurrency group cancel-in-progress on PRs; path filters for docs-only changes; cache global pnpm store for big CI time reductions.
